faq.question: What is a marketplace take rate?
faq.answer: The percentage of each sale the platform keeps before paying you. A 20% take rate means you net 80% of gross revenue.

faq.question: Should I list on a marketplace or sell directly?
faq.answer: Marketplaces offer discovery and built-in billing but take a revenue cut. Direct sales keep more margin but require your own traffic, support, and payment stack. Many builders do both.

faq.question: What fees are not shown in the take rate?
faq.answer: Payment processing (usually 2.9% + 30¢), payout fees, chargebacks, refunds, ads, and the cost of customer support. This calculator estimates net after take rate, processing, ads, and support.

faq.question: Which marketplace is best for AI agents?
faq.answer: OpenAI GPT Store and Poe have the largest consumer reach. Relevance AI and Agent.ai target B2B buyers. Dify and Flowise are better for developer and agency audiences.

faq.question: Can I charge subscription pricing on these marketplaces?
faq.answer: Some platforms support subscriptions (Poe, Relevance, Gumroad, Stripe Billing). Others rely on usage-based pools (OpenAI GPT Store) or one-time template sales.
